create_cosine_decay_scheduler: create a CosineDecay learning rate scheduler for an optimizer with a specified maximum number of iterations
create_cosine_warmup_scheduler: create a CosineWithWarmupAndLRScaling scheduler that combines linear warmup with cosine decay and layer-wise LR scaling
build_param_groups_layer_decay: build parameter groups with layer-wise learning rate decay for a VisionTransformer model using get_param_groups_with_layer_decay
build_param_groups_weight_decay: build parameter groups separating weight decay and no decay params for any PyTorch model using get_param_groups_with_weight_decay
get_layer_id_from_param: get the layer ID from a parameter name string using get_layer_id to map params to their transformer layer index
